intro: Elemental Unrest is an introductory task given by Rorian the Dayseeker on Zephras Isle. Following the departure of the island's sentient elemental benefactors, the lesser wind spirits near the Thendal Standing Stones have grown agitated and unpredictable. You are sent into Thendal Grove to find Rorian's apprentice, Yala Windwatcher, and discover what is unsettling the local breeze.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.
Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them.
My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.
